summary: Frontend-only visual QA completed on the public deployment across desktop and 375px mobile. Light body background, white foreground surfaces, darkened card/input borders, text contrast, hover colors, dark-mode restoration, Poppins, rupee rendering, and all four authenticated role pages passed. Found three regressions: the hero search card uses a harsh black border, the intended active-tab #5C76D4 box-shadow ring is not applied, and opening the mobile Properties filters logs Radix accessibility errors. Placeholder contrast is good but the computed color does not match the requested #6B7A90 token.

ui_bugs.issue: The white search card computes to a 1px rgb(0,0,0) border because it uses border-black. This is visibly harsher than the requested subtle #AEBBD2 card border; reproduced on desktop and 375px mobile.

The requested #5C76D4 outer box-shadow ring is absent from computed styles. Home active tab computes only shadow-md and admin active tab only shadow-sm; neither box-shadow contains rgb(92,118,212). Home still has the explicit #5C76D4 border, but admin active tabs have no equivalent darker outer edge.

Opening Filters at 375px logs the Radix console error 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' twice. The panel is usable and visually correct, but this fails the no-console-errors requirement and screen-reader dialog labeling.

issues: Search query placeholder computes to rgb(82,99,122) rather than the specified rgb(107,122,144) (#6B7A90). It remains clearly readable, so this is a token-consistency issue rather than a contrast failure.

action_items: Replace SearchBar border-black with the subtle card border token/#AEBBD2.
Make the active-tab #5C76D4 ring coexist with Tailwind shadow utilities, then verify both home and admin active tabs by computed box-shadow.
Add an accessible SheetTitle (visually hidden if needed) to the mobile Properties filter sheet so opening it produces no Radix console errors.
Raise the placeholder rule specificity or adjust the shared Input placeholder utility so computed placeholders use #6B7A90.
critical_code_review_comments: SearchBar.jsx explicitly declares border-black on the hero card, bypassing the new subtle border palette.

The global active-tab box-shadow is overridden by TabsTrigger's data-[state=active]:shadow plus per-page shadow-md/shadow-sm utilities; setting the entire box-shadow in competing rules prevents the requested ring from surviving.
Properties.jsx renders SheetContent without SheetTitle, which directly causes the Radix accessibility console error on mobile.
Shared Input applies placeholder:text-muted-foreground with higher selector specificity than the global ::placeholder rule, so the intended #6B7A90 color does not win.
The production build succeeds but still emits React Hook dependency warnings in 11 page modules, including role dashboards and admin CRUD pages.

success_rate.frontend: 88% visual acceptance; all routes and core theme states loaded

seed_data_creation: None. Existing records were only read; no data was created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used. Body was rgb(224,231,250) on /, /properties, /projects, /blog, active property/project details, /login, /admin, /agent, /developer, and /dashboard. Cards were white with rgb(174,187,210) borders; inputs used rgb(185,196,218); admin SEO slate-400 text was rgb(100,116,139); stat labels were rgb(82,97,122). Dark mode passed with body rgb(22,46,42), white text, hero-dark visible, and Select panel rgb(28,56,51). Prior dark Select defect is fixed. Desktop and exact 375px home/properties/admin had no horizontal overflow. Property-card and pagination hover borders changed successfully. All required seeded credentials worked. No console/page/HTTP errors occurred except the mobile Properties SheetTitle warning.
rca_of_the_issue: SearchBar hardcodes border-black. Active tab controls apply Tailwind shadow utilities that override the later intended ring because all rules write box-shadow. Properties mobile SheetContent omits the required accessible title. Shared Input's placeholder:text-muted-foreground selector overrides the low-specificity global ::placeholder color rule. Reproduce via Home computed styles and by opening Properties > Filters at 375px while monitoring console errors.
